guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest latency shift (p90 0.0044 to 0.2109, z=+944) and sits downstream of recommendationservice, checkoutservice and frontend, whose latencies rise in proportion to it. There are no errors in logs or traces and no CPU, memory, disk or socket metrics in the top series, while workload falls about 23%, which fits a latency-only fault, but the digest has no direct evidence to separate delay from loss or CPU.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice for network delay or a slow dependency (e.g. tc/netem rules, pod network path) and remove the delay source, or restart or reschedule the affected pod if it is confirmed to be the one degraded.
